taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1420 | 1.44 | 1.44
2 | 859 | 1.49 | 2.93
3 | 987 | 14.5 | 17.4
4 | 2246 | 33.5 | 50.9
5 | 34337 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HAK-type
Aquifer depth: 17.4 – 50.9 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of approximately 50 m to tap the high-resistivity, prolific sandy aquifer identified in Layer 4. Terminate drilling before penetrating the highly resistive bedrock at 50.9 m, and install well screens within the 17.4 to 50.9 m zone with appropriate gravel packing.
